title: Nanoleaf’s colorful pegboard and shelf kit is half off
summary: It can hold everything from headphones to notebooks while rocking your favorite colors. Of course, the light panels support custom lighting scenes, and Nanoleaf’s app has a feature called Paint Tool that lets you set where each color appears.
